info.name: Listrak Cross Channel REST app-push-mobile-client-device Message API

params.name: listId
params.description: Identifier used to locate the list.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Value indicating the page of data that's being retrieved. The default value is `Start`.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of data members to be displayed per page. The default value is `1000` and the maximum value is `5000`.

params.name: startDate
params.description: The start of the date range used for filtering.

params.name: endDate
params.description: The end of the date range used for filtering.

params.name: includeTestMessages
params.description: Whether test messages should be included in the collection. The default value is `false`.

items.docs: Returns a collection of messages for the specified list.

params.name: listId
params.description: Identifier used to locate the list.

params.name: sendDate
params.description: The send date for the message.

params.name: sendTestMessage
params.description: Whether a test message should be sent. The default value is `false`.

params.name: sendReviewMessage
params.description: Whether a review message should be sent. The default value is `false`.

params.name: testEmailAddress
params.description: Test email address that will be used to preview the scheduled message.

items.docs: Sends a new message on the specified list.

params.name: listId
params.description: Identifier used to locate the list.

params.name: messageId
params.description: Identifier used to locate the message.
